svg.desc: State Security Headquarters LOCATION · 13 REGIONS Riyadh Makkah Madinah Qassim Eastern Asir Tabuk Hail Northern Borders Jazan Najran Al-Baha Al-Jouf CLIENT Presidency of State Security – Ministry of Interior STATUS EST. VALUE In progress 95 million SAR DISCIPLINES Urban planning and design Mechanical Electrical Structural / civil Project Overview Providing consultancy services for the projects of the Presidency of State Security throughout the Kingdom (Riyadh Region, Makkah Region, Madinah Region, Qassim Region, Eastern Province, Asir Region, Tabuk Region, Hail Region, Northern Borders Region, Jazan Region, Najran Region, Al-Baha Region, Al-Jawf Region). BECT's scope included project management, site supervision and tender documents. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and structural / civil engineering.
